title: neottia morrisonicola
intro: Neottia morrisonicola, commonly known as Morrison's Adder's-mouth Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Taiwan. This plant is a type of terrestrial orchid that has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Neottia morrisonicola include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
